messages:
deploybot: Scheduling v2 rollout for "public-api" on 2026-03-10T18:00Z. Release tag r-20260310-v2. Canary cadence: 1% -> 8% -> 35% -> 100% with 9m ramps. Operators: @rachel (lead) @tom (backup). Reply `ack` to accept. Command: `/deploy r-20260310-v2 --canary --shadow-traffic`
rachel: ack. I'll run initial canary in eqiad on a 4-host pool then region-fade. Will verify TLS handshakes and keep an eye on connection pooling metrics.
priya: Note: this release changes header normalization: we now canonicalize `X-Request-ID` to `x-request-id` and tighten cookie domain validation. Need to call out in release notes and customer-facing changelog.
dan: Pinlist check: 5 tenants pinned to v1 (enterprise-billing and gov). They are exempt from automatic flip; will remain on v1 until 2026-04-01. I updated pin-bridge so logs include `tenant_pin: v1`.
priya: Also, SDK teams: server libs will emit `x-api-version: 2` in next patch; mobile team shipping a one-retry fallback that retries once with v1 for devices older than version 1.9.0. Expect a tiny increase in 429s for legacy clients during first hour.
ton: quick preflight smoke (staging):
```bash
curl -I -H "x-api-version: 2" https://staging.public-api/health | egrep -i "x-runtime|x-request-id|status"
```
Expect `HTTP/2 200`, header `x-runtime: redwood` and `x-request-id` present.
oncall-bot: Canary monitors created: `rollout_v2_publicapi`. Pager thresholds: 5xx > 0.35% over 5m OR error delta > 25 in 5m. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/publicapi-canary
rachel: Proposed rollback criteria:
- sustained 5xx > 1% for 7m OR
- p95 latency increase > 220ms for 10m OR
- validation error tag `cookie_domain_invalid` >= 30 in 10m
Rollback steps: revert to r-20260201-v1, open #incidents-publicapi, add `release:reverted` tag and run emergency migration patch if needed.
dan: pre-deploy checklist: pinlist verified, infra templates applied, warm-up run scheduled 12m before, traffic-shadow enabled for 30m prior.
priya: Heads-up for docs: please add a snippet showing old vs new cookie domain behavior and a quick migration curl showing how to set the header explicitly.
legal-bot: Compliance note: tokens issued during the soft-cutover retain 30d audit logs. Confirm data-retention messaging in release notes.
rachel: Dry-run scheduled at T-10m. Will post smoke screenshots and a short dashboard share at T+12. If dry-run passes, we start canary at scheduled time.
deploybot: Dry-run initiated: `/deploy r-20260310-v2 --dry-run`. Dry-run result: smoke tests passed, two minor warnings about header casing in one microservice (svc-cache). Logs: https://go/logs/r-20260310-dryrun
tom: I'll handle svc-cache patch if it regresses. Small fix is queued and can be hotpatched within 6m.
rachel: Reminder: do not force-unpin tenants. If operator needs to flip a tenant, escalate to @dan for manual approval.
priya: Analytics plan: tag legacy requests with `client_version:legacy` and surfacing `migration_attempts` metric. We'll produce a dashboard share at T+8.
deploybot: Canary started: phase 1 (1%) in eqiad. Canary ID c-20260310-1. Watchers: @rachel @tom @oncall.
ton: T+5 check: 2xx ratio 99.7%, 5xx spike at 0.12% (within thresholds), p95 latency +30ms. No `cookie_domain_invalid` events. Posting snapshot: https://go/dashboards/snapshot/t+5
priya: Good so far. Note the svc-cache warning cleared after restarting cache replica.
rachel: T+20 update: widening to 35%. 5xx steady at 0.2%, p95 +40ms. Analytics shows legacy client retries ~0.8% of traffic. Holding before final ramp.
legal-bot: Confirmed release notes include retention sentence. No blockers from compliance.
oncall-bot: Alert: Anomaly detected in eu-west-1 connections (small spike). Alert id a-789123. 5xx moved to 0.6% in the region for 3m.
rachel: Investigating region anomaly. Tom, can you check proxy pools in eu-west and the connection drains?
tom: Investigating. I see short-lived backlog on proxy-2 causing upstream timeouts. Kicking a graceful drain and scaling proxy pool by +2.
priya: Surface note: if cookie validation errors appear, we will hold at current percent and run targeted hotfix.
rachel: T+35 decision: anomaly contained after scaling. We will proceed to 100% in 10m if no regressions. Rolling to 100% now.
deploybot: Rollout complete. Release state: `active` r-20260310-v2. Metrics: global 5xx 0.18%, p95 +45ms. Canaries closed.
dan: Post-release: created postmortem checklist and pinned migration metrics to the dashboard for 72h. Tenants still pinned remain on v1 until manual opt-in.
priya: Will update release notes with a short troubleshooting FAQ and a note about header normalization.
rachel: Thanks team. If any late regressions, open #incidents-publicapi and call the rollback play. Good job. :tada:
